subject.title: [Feature]: No way to view/manage paired contacts & permissions

question: Should OpenClaw add a terminal admin contact inventory for WhatsApp pairing and allowlists, and what fields, redaction, account scope, and authorization should it expose?
rationale: The source gap is real, but listing phone numbers or sender IDs with permission and activity state changes a security-sensitive admin surface and overlaps existing `/allowlist`, directory, channel status, and the narrower approved-pairing request.

options.title: Define scoped admin inventory
options.body: Add a designed CLI/admin surface that merges pairing-store approvals, config allowlists, directory labels, and an explicitly chosen activity source under redaction and account-scope rules.

options.title: Narrow to pairing management first
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/56621 as the first step and defer group-policy and last-active columns until their privacy and storage model is decided.

options.title: Defer to broader admin UI
options.body: Keep terminal surfaces as-is and require a Control UI or broader admin model before adding another permission-management command.

recommendation.title: Define scoped admin inventory
recommendation.body: Add a designed CLI/admin surface that merges pairing-store approvals, config allowlists, directory labels, and an explicitly chosen activity source under redaction and account-scope rules.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest shared history is around `/allowlist`, pairing CLI, and allowFrom store boundaries, which are the product seams this decision must reconcile.
